newsitem.title: USA: CBOT November rice drops on backspreading, cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT November rice drops on backspreading, cash.

text.p: Hints that key cash markets were showing signs of weakness and backspreading knocked nearby CBOT November rice to a sharply lower close, traders said.
"November was lower on indications something has changed in the cash market," a trader said.
Traders said demand was slow and they noted talk that the benchmark Thai market was weaker.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 400 contracts, above the 304 traded Thursday, according to the CBOT.
Rice closed unchanged to 15 cents per cwt lower, with November down 15 at $10.14 per cwt.
